verdict.rationale: Benchmark's own API docs cover a substantial slice of the UI. That includes contact search, full list management, campaign setup, report retrieval and scoped keys. But the docs themselves show the API falls short of UI parity: design edits and sending happen in the app after an API duplicate, and sending domains are read-only. Missing for 10: API-driven email design/content editing, API campaign send/scheduling, write access to sending domains, API coverage of forms, automations and the AI builder, and a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Create, rename, duplicate, merge, and delete lists from another system.
Set up the campaign name, subject line, sender details, and recipient list via the API.
Duplicate a previous campaign via the API to inherit its design, then open it in Benchmark to make final edits and send.
Read-only access to the verification status of your private sending domains.
Pull campaign results into your BI tool, your weekly digest, or whatever dashboard you actually look at.
